description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320290
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
